text:
Alice M: Quick heads-up — ran the v2.1-int4 bring-up shadow on the longdoc-summarization slice in staging. baseline (v2.0-fp16) vs v2.1-int4 looks fine on mean ROUGE, but the 95th-percentile MRR and hallucination tail moved.
Ben K: which slices/bins? numbers pls.
Alice M: gist below. I'm seeing a concentrated degradation on documents > 10k tokens (longtail). short summary: mean ROUGE change +0.6, MRR_p95 -2.1 pts, halluc_rate +1.3ppt.
Alice M: ```
anchor_model: v2.0-fp16
candidate: v2.1-int4
metrics: {"rouge_mean": 0.606 -> 0.612, "mrr_p95": 0.86 -> 0.839, "halluc_rate_longtail": 0.018 -> 0.031}
sample_count_longtail: 420
```
Cara S: ugh, that's a pretty sharp tail move. is this reproducible on a fresh shadow run?
Alice M: re-ran with a fresh seed and larger sample (1.2k longtail examples). same direction; mrr_p95 delta consistent ~ -2.0 pts, halluc up ~1.1ppt.
Ben K: did you check KV-cache warmup differences? int4 sometimes loses some attention precision on very long contexts.
Alice M: checked per-token perplexity drift and kv-warmup hit rate — warmup looks fine. also verified no sequence-truncation bug.
Dino-bot: shadow-run #5482 completed (metrics posted to /runs/5482).
Elaine R: can you paste the gating config we're using for the canary? I want to see the thresholds and smoothing window.
Alice M: current canary config (staging promote) is pretty conservative:
```
- window: 6h
- compare_to: anchor
- gating_metrics: [mrr_p95, halluc_rate, mean_rouge]
- absolute_thresholds: {mrr_p95_drop: 0.015, halluc_rate_increase: 0.02}
- smoothing: simple 3-bucket majority (no EWMA)
- contiguous_buckets_required: 2
```
Alice M: Given the longtail noise, I'm proposing two changes before we promote: 1) introduce an anchored-EWMA smoothing on longtail slices with half-life = 8h, 2) require 3 contiguous buckets exceeding thresholds OR a weighted delta >= 1.25x of threshold when sample_count_longtail < 500.
Ben K: sounds reasonable. do you have a suggested rule we can implement atomically?
Alice M: proposed auto-fallback rule to add to rollout config:
```
name: longtail_anchor_safety
trigger_if_any:
  - metric: mrr_p95
    comparator: delta_lt
    threshold: 0.015
    smoothing: ewma_hl_8h
  - metric: halluc_rate_longtail
    comparator: delta_gt
    threshold: 0.01
  - sample_guard:
      when_count_lt: 500
      multiplier: 1.25
  - hysteresis:
      contiguous_buckets: 3
      cooldown: 30m
action: immediate-fallback
```
Cara S: also add a soft-alert path that pages on-call if halluc_rate_longtail > 0.02 even if mrr delta is marginal. we don't want to silently slip that.
Ben K: agree. we should also log anchor drift score (KL or embedding-cos) to identify covariate shifts.
Alice M: added that to the rule draft; I'll open a PR to add these to the staged-canary policy and wire the shadow job to re-run for 24h with new smoothing windows.
Dino-bot: created issue #ML-8234: "longdoc int4 bring-up: anchor-EWMA smoothing + fallback rule" assigned to @Alice M.
Elaine R: good. please include a reproducible eval artifact (not just aggregated numbers) — we want sample ids for the failing docs and a small diff-run that highlights failure modes.
Alice M: will attach the artifact and a ~100-sample failure set in the PR. quick ask: @Ben K / @Cara S can you review the PR today so we can decide whether to block the promote?
Ben K: I'll look this afternoon.
Cara S: I can review after 4pm PT. :thumbsup:
Alice M: thanks — provisional plan: hold the promote until EWMA smoothing + extra sampling run completes; if rule fires we auto-fallback and open a follow-up to debug quantization rounding on attention matrices.
Ben K: sounds good.
Elaine R: thanks for catching this early.
